Title: Scaffold decoration
Description: Grows new molecules around a small ring fragment lifted out of the input rather than decorating its full scaffold, returning up to 100 structures per query. Generation runs through SAFE, a rewriting of SMILES in which a molecule becomes an unordered set of fragment blocks, with Noutahi and colleagues pretraining an 87-million-parameter GPT-2 style model on 1.1 billion SAFE strings from ZINC and UniChem. Cores of 60 to 100 Da carrying an attachment point are selected here, and sampling is stochastic, so runs differ.
Interpretation: Up to 100 molecules grown stochastically from small 60 to 100 Da ring cores extracted from the input.
